targets.query:
import "regexp"

from(bucket: "vyos")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog" and r._field == "message" and r.host == "fw-wan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value =~ /^\[ipv[46]-[A-Z]+-.+-[^-]+-[A-Z]\]/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: 1, rule: regexp.replaceAllString(r: /^\[ipv[46]-[A-Z]+-(.+)-([^-]+)-[A-Z]\].*$/, v: r._value, t: "$1 #$2")}))
  |> group(columns: ["rule"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Firewall log
panels.description: Rules with `log` write a kernel line ([ipv4-NAM-<chain>-<rule>-<D|A|R>] IN= OUT= SRC= DST= ...) to the syslog, which Telegraf stores in InfluxDB. Newest first, up to 500.

targets.query:
import "regexp"

field = (re, v) => if v =~ re then regexp.replaceAllString(r: re, v: v, t: "$1") else ""

from(bucket: "vyos")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "syslog" and r._field == "message" and r.host == "fw-wan")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value =~ /^\[ipv[46]-[A-Z]+-.+-[^-]+-[A-Z]\]/)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      a = field(re: /^\[ipv[46]-[A-Z]+-.+-[^-]+-([A-Z])\].*$/, v: r._value)
      return {
        _time: r._time,
        Chain: field(re: /^\[ipv[46]-[A-Z]+-(.+)-[^-]+-[A-Z]\].*$/, v: r._value),
        Rule: field(re: /^\[ipv[46]-[A-Z]+-.+-([^-]+)-[A-Z]\].*$/, v: r._value),
        Action: if a == "A" then "accept" else if a == "D" then "drop" else if a == "R" then "reject" else a,
        In: field(re: /^.*[\] ]IN=([^ ]*).*$/, v: r._value),
        Out: field(re: /^.* OUT=([^ ]*).*$/, v: r._value),
        Proto: field(re: /^.* PROTO=([^ ]*).*$/, v: r._value),
        Source: field(re: /^.* SRC=([^ ]*).*$/, v: r._value),
        Sport: field(re: /^.* SPT=([^ ]*).*$/, v: r._value),
        Destination: field(re: /^.* DST=([^ ]*).*$/, v: r._value),
        Dport: field(re: /^.* DPT=([^ ]*).*$/, v: r._value),
      }
  })
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 500)
